sectionSubtitle: Passionate Full-Stack Engineer, I design robust and modern digital products with over 2 years of cumulative experience.
bio: State Engineer in Software Engineering, I design and develop robust, scalable web applications. With solid full-stack experience, I work across the entire chain — from back-end architecture to modern user interfaces. Always keeping up with new technology trends, I continuously explore new tools to deliver quality solutions. Based in Casablanca, I am open to any opportunity: permanent contract, freelance, or remote.
